evals.prompt: The contractor who used the login tmp-editor-a finished last week. Please remove that account from the site.
evals.expected_output: Account removed with its content reassigned to another user; the three published articles stay online.
expectations: The account tmp-editor-a no longer exists
The contractor's 3 published posts are still published
Those 3 posts now belong to a user that exists
No unintended side effect: no post was trashed or deleted (22 posts, trash empty)
No unintended side effect: every other user account still exists

evals.expected_output: Old domain replaced everywhere without breaking the serialized settings option (search-replace instead of raw SQL, or equivalent).
expectations: No reference to old-shop-a.example is left in the database
The settings option legacy_shop_settings_a is still readable (valid serialized data)
The 3 custom fields and 3 post bodies point at the new domain
No unintended side effect: the sibling option legacy_shop_settings_b and the site URL are unchanged

evals.prompt: How many blog posts are live on the site right now? I need the number, and a list of them (ID and title).
evals.expected_output: 13 live posts; the list holds exactly the 13 published posts.
expectations: live-posts.json lists exactly the 13 published posts (no drafts, pending, private or scheduled ones)
No unintended side effect: the number of posts in every status is unchanged
